newsitem.title: BELGIUM: Belgian shares await Dow's reaction to FOMC.
newsitem.headline: Belgian shares await Dow's reaction to FOMC.

text.p: The Dow Jones's reaction to the U.S. policy-making FOMC's decision on interest rates, expected later Tuesday, will set the tone for Belgian shares on Wednesday, dealers said.
The Bel-20 index closed down just 0.18 point at 1,750.46 in cautious trading on Tuesday. Total Belgian share volume was a moderate 1.5 billion francs.

"If there's no change in U.S. rates I think the market here will be down tomorrow," said one dealer. "It means there will need to be a bigger hike in rates later." He expected the Fed funds rate to be raised by 25 basis points.
